items.headline: OpenAI releases GPT-5.2-Codex
items.summary: GPT-5.2-Codex is a coding-focused variant of GPT-5.2 with context compaction for long tasks, large refactors and migrations, and improved Windows performance. It launched in Codex for paid ChatGPT users, with API availability following in January 2026.

image.alt: GPT-5.2-Codex results on SWE-Bench Pro and Terminal-Bench 2.0
